answer: Each agent key can open an account, but only a scarce, nontransferable work credential earns access to high-value trades. A rotating set of peers checks the credential against completed tasks and slashes its bonded stake when claims fail; repeated endorsements alone do not qualify. This trellis of costly, verifiable work makes a sybil fleet pay for each identity in labor and collateral, while a canyon of unrelated accounts cannot manufacture trust by voting for itself. At the zenith, an attacker must sustain real output and risk losing stake for every fake agent.
